title: mail-server: move Email/get property check and projection into crate-private project.rs
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E4. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: S.

Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §3 (project.rs), §5.2, §5.3. Pure refactor, no behaviour change.

Move the Email/get property-name check and the per-property projection (default bodyProperties, header:* forms, metadata projection) from crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs (and helpers.rs where they live) into a crate-private src/project.rs exposing check_email_property(name, ctx) and project_email(email, properties). Leave a hook point for a caller-chosen "no implicit id" mode (EmailPush needs it later; Email/get keeps its implicit id). Add one mod line in lib.rs. Do NOT fix the silent dropping of unknown names here (that is the separate follow-up bug bead).
Acceptance: all existing mail-server tests pass unchanged; the public-api snapshot is unchanged.
